purpose: Legacy draft-only collection aid; it is not importable. Use expert-annotation-bundle-v1.template.json and schema for a real sidecar. Do not mark any review accepted until a real qualified reviewer records the decision and evidence.
externalRequirements: Use a qualified, identifiable reviewer and record reviewer qualification and UTC timestamp.
Review against immutable evidence snapshot IDs and source spans, not a mutable current article alone.
Use at least two independent reviewers for material cases and record adjudication for disagreements.
Do not infer labels from lexical overlap, model self-ratings, or deterministic heuristic output.
Preserve consent, authorization, and any required data-handling approval before using analyst study data.
